notes.title: Update 1.3 + Score system explanation
notes.notes:
[h1]Version 1.3 is here![/h1]
[list]
[*]Game name changed to Balls Royale
[*]Discord link added to social icons
[*]Narrow-Boards Power-Up bug fixed - board is able to reach the ends now
[*]Earthquake Power-Up toned down a bit
[*]Disabled Flashbang while spectating
[*]Simple chat spam protection added
[*]"Match Started" sound effect is now muted when all sounds are muted
[*]Added screen refresh rates options
[*]3 new Achievements (Power-Ups x500, Eliminations x500, Wins x250)
[*]More little tweaks and small features
[/list]
New servers coming soon!

[h1]Score system explanation[/h1]
Player's overall score is decreased by 5% with every game started (10% previously).

In-game scores:
+ 1 for every Defence
+ 5 for Elimination
+ 5 for getting Power-Up (+20 if it's "25 Points Power-Up")
+ Place score -> 50 for 1st, 49 for 2nd, [...], 40 for 10th, [...], 1 point for last place
+ Additional 25 score for winning a match
